nodes.title: Case Routing
nodes.summary: How incoming cases reach the right employee with the right priority.

children.title: Automatic Assignment
children.summary: Cases are automatically assigned to eligible employees based on workload, qualifications, and SLA priority.
children.details_html:
Cases are automatically assigned to eligible employees based on workload, qualifications, and SLA priority.

Requirements

  • Employees can be filtered by qualification before assignment.
  • Current workload should influence which employee receives a case.
  • Cases with tighter SLA targets should be assigned first.

Open questions

  • Should assignment consider time zone or shift schedule in the first release?

children.title: Manual Override
children.summary: Supervisors can reassign any open case at any time.
children.details_html:
Supervisors can reassign any open case at any time.

Requirements

  • Overrides require a reason.
  • The previous assignment stays visible in the case history.

children.title: Escalation Rules
children.summary: Cases that breach or approach their SLA are escalated to the responsible supervisor.
children.details_html:
Cases that breach or approach their SLA are escalated to the responsible supervisor.

Requirements

  • Warning at 80% of the SLA window.
  • Escalation at 100% of the SLA window.
  • Escalations notify both the assignee and the supervisor.

nodes.title: Reporting
nodes.summary: Operational reporting for supervisors and administrators.

children.title: Dashboard
children.summary: A single view of open cases, SLA health, and employee workload.
children.details_html:
A single view of open cases, SLA health, and employee workload.

Requirements

  • Filter by team, priority, and date range.
  • SLA health shows counts for on-track, at-risk, and breached cases.

children.title: Scheduled Exports
children.summary: Automatic CSV exports delivered on a schedule.
children.details_html:
Automatic CSV exports delivered on a schedule.

Requirements

  • Exports can be scheduled daily or weekly.
  • Recipients are configured per export.
  • Failed exports retry twice before notifying an administrator.
